'''ARIA''' was an [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] in charge of the [[CI-004 Research Facility]], a [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]<ref name="Op" /> in [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="TORDate">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref>
